comment:
Three findings, all against the maker's own documentation.
1. DEAD CONTROLS: the Man. button (MANUAL_PARAM) and its Latch button are declared at CvToggle8.cpp:91 and placed on the panel at CvToggle8.cpp:299 and 302, and are read nowhere in the module. The manual says section 1's gate input is normalized to the manual All button; it is not.
2. NO NORMALLING: the port tooltips set at CvToggle8.cpp:99, 103 and 104 say every input from section 2 down is normalized to the previous section. The gate inputs are not: CvToggle8.cpp:265 leaves the reading at 0V when a jack is empty. The ON and OFF inputs fall back to the panel knobs, not to the section above: the normOn and normOff arrays at CvToggle8.cpp:167 are local to one section's update and refilled from the knobs each time.
3. OFF-BY-ONE: CvToggle8.cpp:161 reads getPolyVoltage(1) for the attenuverter before the channel loop, so channel 0 of every output is scaled by channel 2 of a polyphonic attenuvert cable. A monophonic cable is unaffected, since getPolyVoltage repeats channel 0.
